I can’t say enough good things about Wilberg and the work he has done with Nala. When we first started, Nala was very fearful and reactive around unfamiliar people and dogs, and I honestly wasn’t sure how much that could change.

Wilberg took the time to really understand her instead of simply labeling her as aggressive. He understands her body language, knows when she needs space, and when to push her outside of her comfort zone. The progress has been incredible. She has walked through busy environments, been around new people, and is now learning to calmly coexist and socialize with other dogs. Seeing her off leash calmly sharing space with another dog was something I genuinely didn’t think we would get to see this soon.

We still have work to do, but Nala is becoming more confident and manageable every day. I’m extremely protective of her and very particular about who I trust with her, so being comfortable leaving her in Wilberg’s care says a lot. I’m so grateful for how far she has come and would absolutely recommend Wilberg and W&M Happy Dogs, especially for anyone with a fearful or reactive dog.

I have a 5-year-old Yorkie who had extremely difficult behavior: he was very reactive to other people and dogs, and became completely uncontrollable every time we went out. I decided to trust W&M Happy Dogs, and after just 3 weeks of training, the change has been radical!

The result of their magic:
Goodbye reactivity: His daily behavior at home and outside has improved remarkably; now walks are a pleasure.
Test passed: We were able to make the 8-hour trip without any problems. At the airport, he behaved impeccably surrounded by so many people, and on the plane, he was perfectly calm throughout the entire flight. It was a complete success!

A heartfelt thank you to Wilberg and Michelle, not only for training him, but for taking such good care of my boy, as if he were their own.
